translated_title: Republican Party Envoy Larry Rubin Lobbies Mexican Senate Against Sheinbaum’s Single-Nationality Reform
original_title: Larry Rubin pide al Senado rechazar reforma de doble nacionalidad impulsada por Sheinbaum
author: José Shaddai Olvera Torres
meta_description: The reform, already approved by the lower house 334–109, would bar dual nationals from running for president, governor, or Mexico City mayor starting in 2028.
